# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository](https://github.com/Lorenzo-SF/ropero/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or include credentials, private model endpoints, or
personal data in the report.

Include the affected version or commit, the impact, and a minimal reproduction
when possible. The maintainer will acknowledge the report and coordinate a fix
and disclosure. There is no guaranteed response-time SLA yet.

## Scope

Reports about Ropero code, installers, model/engine manifests, configuration
handling, and agent connectors are in scope. Vulnerabilities in upstream
engines, agents, model hosts, or model weights should also be reported to their
respective maintainers.
